project.name: Student Management Microservices (Asynchronous, API Gateway Pattern, Kafka)
project.description: Four independent Spring Boot microservices (student, course, enrollment, notification), each owning its own MySQL database and using standard Spring Data JPA for persistence. All cross-service communication is asynchronous over Kafka instead of WebClient/RestClient/OpenFeign. A fifth module, api-gateway (Spring Cloud Gateway), is the single client-facing entry point that path-routes to the four backend services.
